inventory_path_alias.reason: A validation setup observed the unchanged 16 GiB root ceiling. Relocate only the open lazy-proof inventory to approved Disk B; referenced content and path are preserved.

qualification_this_checkpoint.admitted_scope: Lazy certificate queries and checked reduced-pi sine/tangent proof reuse through the tested compositions and interchange.
adverse_results: Initial integration test used a private cache inspector; moved its graph assertions to unit tests, preserving the source and compiler failure.
Query-only proof candidate passed direct proofs but still failed bounded reciprocal composition and two lazy matrices; preserved source and all outcomes.
Root-ceiling setup stops launched no command; an open inventory was relocated with byte verification and a preserved path alias, without raising any ceiling.

The first final-source debug run was terminated by the 16 GiB root guard. External free-space recovery later allowed the identical frozen executable to complete under the original allowance; the proposed 17 GiB allowance was not applied.
Strict Clippy rejected an if-let return; an equivalent question-mark form passed the final complete checks.
qualification_this_checkpoint.cost_interpretation: Functional correctness/completeness repair, not a performance optimization. In these instrumented controls the ratio of median candidate/parent times was about 1.159 for warm materialized pi signs, 1.146 for cold conversion and 1.059 for exact cloning; the trig-sign ratio was about 0.720. Warm conversion/clone ratios were about 0.971/0.976. All samples and the 3720-byte probe-executable growth are retained. These narrow results do not establish whole-workload performance.
qualification_this_checkpoint.cost_scope: Four common exact-dyadic scalar controls and two warmed materialized sign queries through the changed borrowed accessor; one million completed operations per row, five alternating matched runs. Input construction is outside timing. Instrumented timing is not a general benchmark claim.
qualification_this_checkpoint.decision: Retain lazy borrowed certificate reconstruction and checked native sine/tangent proof replay.
qualification_this_checkpoint.implementation: Borrow existing graphs through Cow; reconstruct only absent named payloads. Share the same native checked pi-multiple proof at exact-sign query, sine/tangent construction and transparent Node import. Preserve existing imported metadata defaults and the constant-time immediate-sign/reducer contract.
qualification_this_checkpoint.input_domain: Valid named Real certificates with absent/null payloads; native PrescaledSin/PrescaledTan graphs whose argument is a nonzero rational pi multiple of magnitude strictly below pi/2, recognized within the stated graph inspection bound.
qualification_this_checkpoint.next: Validate named-certificate/graph consistency and undefined graph domains before reconsidering withheld affine cancellation; continue preserved strict workload and distribution acceptance.
owners: Computable reduced-pi sign proof, native trigonometric construction and transparent Node import
qualification_this_checkpoint.proof: For -1/2 < q < 1/2 and q != 0, sin(pi*q) and tan(pi*q) have sign(q). Exact native rational binary magnitude proves the strict interval; negations and checked binary shifts preserve the relation. Zero, endpoints, other quadrants, unsupported/undefined graphs and overflow cannot inherit this witness.
remaining_limitations: Malformed named-certificate consistency and arbitrary undefined graph domains remain open.
The earlier automatic reciprocal equality workflow remains open; this acceptance uses the previously declared explicit exact normal-form workflow.
The rejected boxed cache remains rejected and explicit affine subtraction remains withheld.
Full native workloads, all bindings, distribution/release and the complete pre-push workflow matrix were not rerun.
Raw evidence depends on the recorded Disk B retention location; historical missing artifacts were not reaudited or recovered.
qualification_this_checkpoint.representation: No public API, wire schema, authoritative expression, Real/Node/cache layout or allocation field changes. Round-trip bytes and null payloads remain unchanged. No serialized cache hint or Real class tag is treated as this new proof.
qualification_this_checkpoint.resource_limits: The recognizer inspects at most 32 nodes, including leaf lookahead. This is not a bound on rational coefficient bytes or all import/refinement work. No arbitrary-graph internal total-work or heap bound is claimed; validation uses external containment. Retained native proofs use existing atomic fact storage.
